description.value: Angus T is a Belgian-style artisan croissant bakery founded in 2016 in West Vancouver, built around a family recipe passed down through generations from a small village in Belgium. Every pastry — from classic butter croissants to inventive flavours like pistachio raspberry and dark chocolate raspberry — is handcrafted daily in an open kitchen using locally sourced and European ingredients. The warm, welcoming space also serves a full lineup of specialty coffee drinks, making it a natural stop for cyclists seeking a quality pastry and espresso.
